expectations.text: Response says to set base in vite.config.ts to /<repo-name>/ for GitHub Pages subdirectory routing.
expectations.evidence: vite.config.ts base setting is not mentioned anywhere. Response covers general GitHub Pages setup (branch, folder, gh-pages branch) without the Vite-specific base path requirement needed for subdirectory routing.

expectations.text: Response provides the GitHub Pages URL pattern: https://<github-username>.github.io/<repo-name>/
expectations.evidence: Response shows: `https://<username>.github.io/<repo-name>/` in the GitHub Pages setup steps.

expectations.text: Response states both URLs must be kept in README.md so judges browsing the GitHub repo can reach the live app in one click without going to Replit.
expectations.evidence: Response includes a README template with a 'Live Links' table: 'Replit | https://<project>.replit.app' and 'GitHub Pages | https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/'. Checklist also includes 'README has both URLs'.

expectations.text: Response explains the GitHub Actions deploy workflow triggers on every push to main, and references the okhp3-vite-github-pages skill for the full runbook.
expectations.evidence: Response shows `on: push: branches: [main]` in the deploy.yml — the trigger is correct. But the okhp3-vite-github-pages skill is not referenced; a general Actions workflow is provided inline instead.

needs_review: Without-skill response omits the vite.config.ts base setting — this would cause asset path 404s on the GitHub Pages subdirectory URL. A developer following this advice without the skill would produce a broken Pages deploy.
